cases.name: P0-canonical
cases.reason: canonical signature-positive payload in a single TCP segment

cases.name: P1-boundary-segments
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload split at parser and required-content boundaries

cases.name: P2-many-small-segments
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload split into many small TCP segments

cases.name: P3-retransmission
cases.reason: signature-positive canonical payload with one byte-identical retransmitted data segment

cases.name: P4-lowercase-uri
cases.reason: signature-positive endpoint literal replayed in lower case, which nocase accepts

cases.name: N-wrong-method
cases.reason: GET replaces the required POST method

cases.name: N-uri-endpoint-changed
cases.reason: URI targets a different receiver endpoint

cases.name: N-uri-not-at-start
cases.reason: endpoint literal is present but preceded by a proxy path

cases.name: N-pcre-not-micros-path
cases.reason: filename parameter points outside the MICROS install path

cases.name: N-pcre-other-six-byte-install-path
cases.reason: filename parameter keeps the Windows drive path shape and a six-byte directory, but the directory is not MICROS

cases.name: N-jndiname-parameter-absent
cases.reason: URI carries a differently named jndi parameter

cases.name: N-username-parameter-absent
cases.reason: URI carries a differently named user parameter

cases.name: N-parameters-out-of-order
cases.reason: username precedes jndiname, so the ordered distance constraint fails

cases.name: N-content-type-changed
cases.reason: upload is form-urlencoded instead of multipart

cases.name: N-content-type-not-at-start
cases.reason: multipart literal is present but not at the start of http.content_type

cases.name: N-referer-header-present
cases.reason: a Referer header is present, which the negated predicate forbids

cases.name: N-internal-source-address
cases.reason: canonical payload originates inside the monitored network

cases.name: N-wrong-destination-address
cases.reason: canonical payload is sent to a server outside the monitored network

cases.name: N-flow-not-established
cases.reason: canonical payload is sent without a completed TCP handshake

cases.name: N-wrong-direction
cases.reason: canonical request bytes replayed to client, so the source is internal and request buffers stay empty

cases.name: N-random-http-request
cases.reason: protocol-valid HTTP request that satisfies no combination of rule predicates
